title_sq: Zyre per shitje tek Aura Residence!
description_sq:
Zyre per shitje tek Aura Residence!
Ekskluzivisht per shitje ofrojme zyre ne nje nga projektet me cilesore ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha.
Ambjenti ndodhet ne katin e peste te objektit te dedikuar per zyra, buze rruges kryesore me vizibilitet maksimal dhe fasade totale xhami.
Objekti eshte i paisur me dy ashensore me akses te menjehershem nga rruga kryesore.
Mundesi shume e mire per ti dhene nje potencial te ri aktivitetit tuaj te biznesit ne nje zone qe po merr zhvillim maksimal fale projekteve te shumta dhe cilesore qe po ndertohen ne zone.
Ambjenti eshte ne fazen perfundimtare te punimeve, qe mund te personalizohet ne rifinitura sipas kerkesave tuaja.
Shume e pershtatshme per aktivitete sherbimi, klinika mjekesore, zyra te tipologjive te ndryshme etj.
Mundesi blerje poste parkimi me cmim ekstra!
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
title_en: Office for sale at Aura Residence!
description_en: Office for sale at Aura Residence! Exclusively for sale we offer an office in one of the highest quality projects on Dritan Hoxha Street. The space is located on the fifth floor of the building dedicated to offices, on the edge of the main street with maximum visibility and a total glass facade. The building is equipped with two elevators with immediate access from the main road. Very good opportunity to give a new potential to your business activity in an area that is receiving maximum development thanks to the numerous and quality projects being built in the area. The environment is in the final stage of works, which can be customized in refinishing according to your requests. Very suitable for service activities, medical clinics, offices of various types, etc. Possibility to buy parking post at an extra price! For more information, contact me.
